name: Rafael Costa
bio:
Rafael's journey into motorsport PR began unconventionally. After graduating with a degree in journalism, he initially covered local football. However, a chance encounter at a karting event sparked a passion for racing. He quickly transitioned, volunteering at local teams to gain experience. His ability to craft compelling narratives and build relationships with both drivers and journalists led to rapid advancement. 

Rafael is known for his calm and collected demeanor, even in high-pressure situations. He believes in transparency and authenticity, building genuine connections with the media and the fanbase. He's particularly adept at leveraging social media to amplify the team's message and manage its public image. What sets him apart is his analytical approach; he constantly tracks media coverage and adjusts strategies based on data, ensuring maximum impact.

At Walkinshaw Andretti United, Rafael is responsible for shaping the team's external communications. He oversees press releases, media events, and social media campaigns, ensuring that the team's achievements and values are effectively communicated to the world. His dedication to building strong relationships with stakeholders makes him an invaluable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight wave
physical.description: Rafael is of average height with a lean build and a warm smile.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas.
Has a collection of miniature racing helmets on his desk.
Starts every media briefing with a deep breath and a sip of water.
